notes.title: 🌌 MAJOR UPDATE: Become the CryptGoddess & Survive the Wild 🐻 PART 2
notes.content:
🌌 MAJOR UPDATE: Become the CryptGoddess & Survive the Wild 🐻

Attention Hunters and Props! 🕵️‍♀️🎭 Disguise Royale has received its most electrifying update yet! With massive gameplay changes, thrilling new challenges, and dynamic enhancements, it’s time to dive in and experience the chaos! Here's what’s new:

👑 Hunter Transformation: You Are the CryptGoddess!
Step into the shadowy power of the CryptGoddess, your new Hunter character.

🖤 A Stunning Makeover: Hunters now take on the form of the CryptGoddess, complete with mesmerizing animations that make every move feel legendary.
💥 Gameplay Impact: This isn’t just a visual upgrade—your strikes feel heavier, deadlier, and more impactful than ever.
🐻 Beware the Bear: A New Threat Arrives!
The battlefield just got wilder with the addition of a fearsome bear!

🧭 How It Works: The bear roams the map, targeting ONLY Hunters. That’s right—props can breathe easy while the Hunters are on the run!
⚔️ Fight or Flight? Hunters can choose to fight the bear or flee while hunting down props. Either way, the bear is relentless and will keep the pressure high!
🕹️ Gameplay Twist: This forces Hunters to strategize like never before—hunt props, survive the bear, or both? The choice is yours.
🎵 Immersive Changes for Everyone
We’ve added layers of polish to make every match more intense and satisfying:

Slower Hunter Attack Speed: Swing wisely—your attacks are now slower but more calculated, adding tension to every encounter.
Enhanced Audio Design: New sounds bring the game to life, from the CryptGoddess’s ominous movements to the bear’s thunderous roars. 🎶
Fluid Animations: The CryptGoddess moves with grace and power, making every step and strike look breathtaking.
🔮 Discover the Details
This update is packed with subtle changes and hidden surprises. Think you’ve seen it all? We challenge you to find every secret we’ve tucked into this massive overhaul!

🔥 Ready to Dominate? Jump in NOW!
Will you survive the hunt as a Hunter? Outsmart your pursuers as a Prop? Or maybe… outrun the bear? The hunt is more thrilling, more dangerous, and more fun than ever before.

Let us know what you think, Hunters and Props! 💌 Your feedback shapes the future of Disguise Royale, and we can’t wait to hear your stories. 🌟

Good luck, and may the CryptGoddess guide your path! 🕵️‍♀️🖤🐻

notes.title: 7 JANUARY BIG UPDATE!
notes.content:
🔥 Epic Update is Here! 🔥

🛑 Hunter Boundaries: No more flying out of the map! Hunters are now restricted when mounting props with the "E" key. 🦅🚫
🎵 Sound Enhancements: Props now come alive with collision sounds and jump effects—get ready to hear the action! 🪵💥
🔧 Bug Fixes Galore: The game no longer ends when a player disconnects. Your rounds are safe and uninterrupted! 🌐✔️
⏳ Round Stability: Resolved the glitchy round counter—bye-bye endless bugs! 🐛👋
🎯 Hunter Awareness: Props now trigger a sound when hit, helping Hunters identify sneaky players faster! 🕵️‍♂️🎶
📣 Auto-Prop Sounds: Props are now required to make a sound every 20 seconds—no more hiding forever! (Manual "T" sounds still available.) 🕰️🔊
✨ E-Skill Upgrade: Transforming into props with the "E" skill now comes with an awesome sound effect. Disguises just got cooler! 🎭🔄
👀 Spectator Fixes: All bugs in Spectator mode have been squashed—enjoy a flawless viewing experience! 🧼🔍
🌍 New Map Incoming: Development has begun on a brand-new map. Get hyped for fresh hunting grounds! 🌄🎮
📋 UI Polished: Main menu improvements and redesigned round text displays—sleeker than ever! 🖥️🖌️
Get ready to dive in—happy hunting! 🏹🎉

notes.content:
We’ve made it easier than ever to connect with other players! A new Discord server has been added where you can interact, form teams, and share fun moments while playing Disguise Royale. Join now and be part of our growing community!

Discord: https://discord.gg/e7BE9e8TDJ

Stay tuned for more updates and enjoy the game with others! 🌟

notes.title: 5 January Patch Notes.
notes.content:
New Features:

Round System Added: The game now features a 3-round system, adding more structure and excitement to each match.

Graphical Enhancements: Visual improvements have been made to provide a more immersive and polished gaming experience.
Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, thank you for playing Disguise Royale!
